name: Xue Baihe Guaitan
source:
A horror game about a needy female ghost. A trio of close-knit occult club girls gather late at night to enjoy telling ghost stories. Little do they know that Miss Choker, a ghost that targets girls, is just dying to appear...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款关于贫困女鬼的恐怖游戏。三个关系密切的神秘俱乐部女孩在深夜聚集在一起，享受讲述鬼故事的乐趣。他们殊不知，以女孩为目标的幽灵乔克小姐正迫不及待地出现……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367120/]Steam[/url]]
